The palette

Your logo already had the ramp

The original is not flat orange plus flat yellow. It runs one continuous warm ramp: saturated orange out at the brush ring, easing to soft yellow across the head. That ramp is why the swap works so cleanly, cherry red takes the outer position, gold takes the inner, and every brush stroke and soft edge survives untouched.

Kannada type

The five faces, set in the real lockup

This is your actual logo text, not a sample string, rendered live in each font by your browser, so the conjuncts shape properly. Watch two spots in particular: the ಳ್ಳ in ಬೆಳ್ಳಂದೂರು and the ತ್ಸ in ಉತ್ಸವ. Those are where a badly made font or a careless export falls apart.

Weight

Why Shree Kannada 0870 is greyed out

It is a commercial font from Modular Infotech's Shree-Lipi family, not a free or web font, so it cannot be rendered here or embedded in a shared page without a licence. Your Mac ships Shree Devanagari 714, which sounds close but carries zero Kannada glyphs, it is a Hindi/Marathi face.

To use it properly, buy the Shree-Lipi Kannada package from Modular Infotech, install it, and set the text locally. For the closest free stand-in, Noto Serif Kannada matches its traditional print flavour most nearly.

Briefing

What to put in the prompt

You said you were not sure what information to give. This is the whole list. Miss any one of these and you get back something that looks right on screen and fails at the printer.

    The one rule for AI image tools

    Never let an image generator redraw your Kannada text. Kannada conjuncts get mangled into confident, beautiful nonsense that a non-reader will approve and a reader will spot instantly. Recolour and composite instead, or set the text in a real font, then place the artwork. Write do not regenerate, redraw or re-letter any text into the prompt every single time.

    Ready to send

    Four briefs, filled in with your values

    Paste these as they are. Every colour, dimension and glyph is already your project's, not a placeholder.

    One honest limit. Everything here is derived from your two JPEGs, since there is no vector source in the folder. That is fine for choosing a direction and for screen use. Before anything goes to a large-format printer, a trophy engraver or an embroiderer, have the chosen variant redrawn as vector, the brush ring and the Kannada lettering both. Ask whoever made the original for the layered file first, it will save a day of tracing.
